ritesh-sales: Customer security asked for a compact POC access-control packet: SSO/SAML metadata, enforced MFA evidence, SCIM group-scoped provisioning, RBAC examples showing least-privilege, and one redacted service-account rotation log. Deadline: 2025-07-18 COB. Can we assemble? :clipboard:

mel-sec: I can pull Console > Integrations > SSO screenshots and the roles CSV. Will redact PII from logs.

andre-eng: SAML snippet we hand out: `entity_id=https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata, acs=https://redwood.example.com/saml/consume, name_id=email` — will include metadata URL and ACS for their IdP admin.

zoe-ops: Service accounts: default TTL 30d for app tokens, key-rotator job runs daily. I'll export a redacted rotation event and the rotator Cron config.

mel-sec: MFA policy summary: interactive SSO requires MFA for privileged groups (org-admin, billing-admin); enforced at IdP and validated at session create. I'll attach the policy screenshot and short attestation paragraph.

andre-eng: SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0, group->role mappings, and scoping to only mapped groups. I'll add a HOWTO and a small PATCH example for their test harness.

andre-eng: PATCH example: `curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Groups/{id} -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-123"}]}]}'`

mel-sec: Attestation (draft): "Security attests that the included artifacts reflect Redwood Inference SSO/SCIM/MFA and service account controls as of 2025-07-17. Contact security@redwood.example.com for verification." I'll sign and add contact details.

ritesh-sales: Perfect. Upload target: https://redwood.app/shared/sales/poc-246/evidence. Please drop final files by Fri 18:00 UTC and ping here.

evidence-bot: nightly audit export completed 02:05 UTC (audit-export/2025-07-17-0205.csv).

zoe-ops: Will drop rotator log + redacted audit slice into the folder today.

mel-sec: I'll add screenshots, the roles CSV, attestation, and a short separation-of-duties matrix for org-admin vs billing-admin.

ritesh-sales: Thanks all 44d. Target: final bundle uploaded by Fri 18:00 UTC.
